def: Tending to prepare or make ready; having the power ofpreparing, qualifying, or fitting; preparatory.Laborious quest of knowledge preparative to this work. South.
Suitable to winter; resembling winter, or what belongs towinter; brumal; hyemal; cold; stormy; wintery.Touch our chilled hearts with vernal smile, Our wintry course do thoubeguile. Keble.
A fleet of armed ships; a squadron. Specifically, the Spanishfleet which was sent to assail England, a. d. 1558.
The office of chief justice.Jay selected the chief-justiceship as most in accordance with histastes. The Century.
A week; any period of seven consecutive days and nights. SeeSennight.
One who steers; as, a boat steerer.
Without a bottom; hence, fathomless; baseless; as, a bottomlessabyss. "Bottomless speculations." Burke.

The state of being monstrous, or out of the common order ofnature; that which is monstrous; a monster. South.A monstrosity never changes the name or affects the immutability of aspecies. Adanson (Trans. ).
One who, or that which, muddles.
